document_text: All production LLM inference requests must route through AWS Bedrock inside us-east-1 using IAM task roles. Static third-party API keys are strictly prohibited. Customer PII logs are retained for 30 days in encrypted S3 buckets before automatic deletion.
question: How long are customer PII logs retained and where are they stored?
expected_output: Customer PII logs are retained for 30 days in encrypted S3 buckets before automatic deletion [cloud_security_policy.md].
